programme.desc: After serving as an MSNBC contributor and guest-host on the network for four years, TV and radio personality Michael Smerconish believed he was ready to head a show of his own. CNN agreed, and thus was born `Smerconish', an hourlong Saturday morning program that takes after its host's independent views. Using a topical, conversational format, he aims for the TV show to be an extension of his weekday radio broadcast, with free-flowing topics and the ability to discuss issues that strike a chord with the audience. Along the same lines, he thinks it's important to present the content in an engaging manner, free of my-way-or-the-highway ideology. Smerconish, who has a law degree from the University of Pennsylvania, is also a New York Times' best-selling author.

programme.title: Property Brothers: Buying & Selling

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Gordon visits Flamingos in rural Whitehouse, New Jersey. Mother and daughter owners Adele and Cheryl are stuck in their tropical ways, but their restaurant is far from paradise. They are in deep financial trouble and Adele struggles to get on with her staff, is disappointed by her chef and hates Gordon with a passion. Gordon has one last chance to bring them all around and make the restaurant a success.

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Gordon visits Bazzini restaurant in Ridgewood, New Jersey. Owner Paul Bazzini was an award-winning chef in New York who decided to run his own restaurant, but he never realised how difficult the change would be. Now, he finds everyday tasks overwhelming and his passion for food is in danger of being extinguished by the daily grind. However, passion isn't the only problem in this failing restaurant.

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Gordon visits Mojito, a Cuban café in Brooklyn, New York. Owners Marcelo and Kata used to be married to each other but now fight over everything. Seven years ago, the couple were happy newlyweds and the restaurant was their shared dream, but now the passion has gone, and they're constantly at each other's throats, with their staff getting caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Gordon travels to Queens, New York to visit PJ's Steakhouse, a restaurant he quickly discovers is all sizzle and no steak. Owners Joe and Madalyn have found themselves in serious debt after opening the high-end restaurant. The couple were overcome by grief when Joe's brother PJ passed away. Struggling to move on they decided to take over the lease of PJ's bar and turn it into a restaurant.

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Gordon visits Fleming, a Danish restaurant in Miami, Florida. It was once the best family-run restaurant in town, but now the place is on its last legs. Fleming was bought by husband and wife team Andy and Suzanne eight years ago, in the hope of continuing the restaurant's past success, but with no clue about Danish cuisine it's no real surprise the place is losing money. Can Gordon save their bacon?
